15:45.race_name: Enter ITV7 For Free EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Green when sixth of seven at Lingfield on his debut; can take a step forward
runners.name: Dakota Brave
runners.spotlight: 11-1, looked very much in need of the experience when sixth of seven in a 6f Lingfield novice on his debut 17 days ago; this son of Sioux Nation can take a step forward.

runners.comment: Encouraging debut fifth at Kempton, finishing well; seems sure to do better
runners.name: Location Location
runners.spotlight: 14-1, encouraging debut fifth of ten in 6f Kempton novice 17 days ago, finishing well having been short of room over 1f out; this Harry Angel gelding seems sure to do better.

runners.breeder: J A Knox And Mrs M A Knox
runners.comment: A promising debut third at Ripon, running on late; this Pinatubo colt rates a player
runners.name: Mind Those Steps
runners.spotlight: 7-1 and green, promising third of seven in novice at Ripon (6f, good) on his debut 22 days ago, running on late; this Pinatubo colt rates a player with better to come.

runners.comment: Green when never-dangerous debut fifth at Ripon; looks capable of a fair bit better
runners.name: Thai Ginger
runners.spotlight: Sent off 2-1 favourite but looked green when a never-dangerous fifth of seven in novice at Ripon (6f, good) on his debut 22 days ago; this No Nay Never colt looks capable of a fair bit better.

runners.comment: Showcasing colt; appeals on paper and must enter calculations for powerful stable
runners.name: This Moment
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid
runners.spotlight: Showcasing half-brother to winners Dickensian (Group-placed 5f 2yo; RPR 97) and Time Turner (12.4f; RPR 69); dam, 6f 2yo winner (Group 3; RPR 102), is a half-sister to useful winners Hors De Combat (7f/1m) and Stroll Patrol (6f); appeals on paper and must enter calculations for powerful stable.

runners.comment: This Dark Angel filly needs considering, especially if the market vibes are positive
runners.name: Oh So Slow Sloth
runners.spotlight: 75,000gns yearling; half-sister to 6f/7.5f winner Brighton Boy (RPR 90); dam, runner-up over 6f (RPR 70), is a half-sister to winners Zanetto (6f Listed) and Dream Tune (useful 7f), out of maiden half-sister to 1m1f Group 2 winner Alkhaadem; this Dark Angel filly needs considering, especially if the market vibes are positive.

runners.comment: A dual C&D winner; good fourth at Chester latest so must enter calculations off same mark
runners.name: Go Vince Go
runners.spotlight: A dual C&D winner in an excellent 2025 campaign; got right back on track when fourth of 12 in 6f Chester handicap 11 days ago; must enter calculations off the same mark.

runners.comment: Encouraging sixth at Thirsk 29 days ago; not out of things with that run under his belt
runners.name: Mo Of Cairo
runners.spotlight: Showed fair winning form at 2yrs and he returned from eight months off with an encouraging sixth of 14 in 5f Thirsk handicap 29 days ago, keeping on late; not out of things with that run under his belt.

runners.comment: Good clear second at Ripon last month; not taken lightly despite a 4lb weights rise
runners.name: Mighty Magnus
runners.spotlight: A fair and consistent 5.5f scorer at 2yrs; back from six months off with a good clear second of 13 in 6f Ripon handicap last month; not taken lightly despite a 4lb weights rise.

runners.comment: Enjoyed an excellent winter on the AW; can play a prominent role again back on turf
runners.name: Alasrae
runners.spotlight: Enjoyed an excellent winter on the AW, scoring three times at 6f, and comes here on the back of a good third of ten in 6f Lingfield handicap 19 days ago when not enjoying the smoothest of passages; can play a prominent role again back on turf.

runners.comment: Off the mark in Newcastle maiden on return; must enter calculations back in a handicap
runners.name: Gouken
runners.spotlight: Placed on all his five runs at 2yrs before (gelded) getting off the mark in 6f Newcastle maiden on his return last month; he must enter calculations back in handicap company.

runners.comment: Winning start in handicaps at Bath; up 7lb but looks to have more to offer; likely player
runners.name: Marcellinus
runners.spotlight: Gelded/off five months before taking a step forward to make a winning start in handicaps at Bath (5.5f) last month; up 7lb but this son of Showcasing looks to have more to offer; likely player.

runners.comment: Excellent second at Newcastle 16 days ago; likely capable of better still on turf debut
runners.name: Dandy Breeze
runners.spotlight: Progressive son of Dandy Man who got off the mark in 5f Newcastle novice in January and returned from over three months off with an excellent second of eight in 6f handicap there 16 days ago; likely capable of better still on this turf debut.

runners.comment: In good nick, cheekpieces on when fourth at Newmarket 15 days ago; in the mix once more
runners.name: Cotai Lights
runners.spotlight: Landed 6f Newcastle novice in November and he's continued in good nick in handicaps this spring, cheekpieces on when fourth of 11 at Newmarket (7f) 15 days ago; in the mix once more.

runners.comment: Too free when beating one home in 7f Newmarket handicap last month; needs to bounce back
runners.name: Kody B
runners.spotlight: Signed off for 2025 with 6f maiden victory at Pontefract; went too freely in first-time tongue tie when beating just one home in 7f Newmarket handicap last month though; needs to bounce back.

runners.comment: Spreadeagled his field on first go over 6f at Ripon; interesting handicap debutant
runners.name: Red Spells Danger
runners.spotlight: Improving son of Cotai Glory who spreadeagled his field on his first go over 6f in a Ripon maiden nine days ago; a most interesting handicap debutant.

runners.comment: Suffered interference when ninth at Chester latest; no surprise to see him bounce back
runners.name: Proof
runners.spotlight: Kickstarted 2026 with gutsy 5f Southwell success in April but suffered early interference when ninth in 5f Chester handicap nine days ago; it would come as no surprise to see him bounce back.

runners.comment: Shaped as if run was needed when fifth at Pontefract on return; can take a step forward
runners.name: Daizen
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with breakthrough victory at Ayr (6f); off seven months and shaped as if the run was needed when a fading fifth of seven in 6f Pontefract handicap on his recent return; can take a step forward now.

runners.comment: Failed to kick on in handicaps this season; since gelded and could still do better now
runners.name: Horace Wallace
runners.spotlight: Cosily got off the mark in 6f Wolverhampton novice in February but he failed to kick on in handicaps, only seventh back there (5f) in March; since gelded and could still do better on his turf debut.

runners.comment: Raced on unfavoured part of track when tenth at Leicester on return; not written off
runners.name: Circle Of Trust
runners.owner: Mrs R G Hillen And Partner
runners.spotlight: Signed off at 2yrs with an improved second in 7f Yarmouth nursery; raced on the unfavoured part of the track when tenth in 7f Leicester handicap on his return and shouldn't be written off in a change of headgear.

16:45.race_name: Sky Bet Extra Places Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.comment: Ex-French; well beaten on stable debut at Pontefract (1m2f) last month
runners.name: Military Air
runners.spotlight: Useful in France, finishing third in a Listed race last season (1m4f, good to soft); changed hands for 45,000gns in October but well beaten on stable debut at Pontefract (1m2f; 8-1) last month when making the running in his usual hood; tongue tied last year but not this term; others look more solid.

runners.breeder: Airlie Stud & Mrs S M Rogers
runners.comment: Won from Ride The Thunder at Haydock (1m6f) in September; up 7lb and headgear removed
runners.name: Valiancy
runners.spotlight: Made debut last May and all six runs were on good ground; maiden winner here who was increasingly competitive coming from behind in his three handicaps, winning in first-time cheekpieces from Ride The Thunder at Haydock (1m6f) in September when last seen; up 7lb, back slightly in trip and no headgear, but he's still one to note.

runners.comment: Better than ever with Doncaster win (1m4f, good to firm) in clearcut style on reappearance
runners.name: Ghaiyya
runners.spotlight: Had three 1m4f wins last summer and better than ever when she took a six-runner race at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm) in clearcut style on reappearance three weeks ago, leading over 1f out; up 5lb and she was well held in this higher grade last term, but she is in serious calculations nevertheless.

runners.comment: 0-10 on turf; Newmarket 15 days ago saw first turf run since 2023 and he was last of eight
runners.name: Nolton Cross
runners.spotlight: Six wins (latest in February) from 24 AW starts but 0-10 on turf; Newmarket 15 days ago saw first turf race since 2023 and he came last of eight.

runners.comment: 2nd to Valiancy final 3yo start; gelded since and hooded first time for this reappearance
runners.name: Ride The Thunder
runners.spotlight: Won 1m2f Nottingham maiden last June; on the premises in all his three handicaps, closest last time when he came from the back at Haydock (1m6f, good) but to not quite such good effect in the end as Valiancy who made the same move on the other side of the track; gelded since and hooded first time for this reappearance; up 4lb but looks a serious contender.

runners.breeder: S C E A Ecurie Haras Du Cadran Et Al
runners.comment: His turf strike-rate is just 1-18 and return to turf last time saw him well held
runners.name: Artisan Dancer
runners.spotlight: Industrious and dependable sort over 1m6f-2m2f but his turf strike-rate is just 1-18 and return to turf last time saw him well held.

runners.comment: 582 days off before two runs for new yard this spring; needs to build on those efforts
runners.name: Mountain Road
runners.spotlight: 4-15 for David Simcock; absent for 582 days before having two runs for new yard this spring, runs which showed that significant ability remains but he needs to build on those performances.

runners.comment: Front-runner; first or second in all five races last year but he wasn't seen after July
runners.name: Savrola
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who was progressive last year (over 1m6f, 1m5f here and 2m) and finished either first or second in all five of those races, but he wasn't seen after July; a shorter break (178 days) didn't prevent a win first time out last term and he should be retained in serious calculations.

runners.comment: Won a handicap at Bellewstown (1m3f, soft) before a respectable hurdling effort; shortlist
runners.name: Putapoundinthejar
runners.spotlight: Just five Flat races, faring easily best when he won a handicap at Bellewstown (1m3f, soft) last month; returned to hurdling for a respectable show at Punchestown festival 19 days ago; his trainer's three runners at Chester last week were all well held, albeit with two in the Chester Cup, but this one should have more to offer in this sphere and goes on the shortlist.

runners.comment: Well handicapped but needs to leave his three efforts this season a long way behind him
runners.name: Gibside
runners.spotlight: Strong finish from the rear secured the Chester Plate (2m2f, good) last May off 1lb higher than today and he also won over 1m4f on soft at Catterick in October; needs to leave his three efforts this season a long way behind him, latest when not faring nearly so well with the draw back in Chester Plate, and others have more pressing claims.

runners.comment: Easily best known at Hamilton but needed at least his first run back in previous seasons
runners.name: Spanish Hustle
runners.spotlight: Easily best known at Hamilton where he's 6-20, including two wins last summer; competitive if he returns in last season's peak form but he's needed at least his first run back in previous seasons.

runners.comment: Back-to-form third at Musselburgh (2m) last time but this C&D makes him look vulnerable
runners.name: Trojan Sun
runners.spotlight: Often ridden by Lauren Young; 4-12 at Musselburgh, including three 1m6f/2m wins on good ground last May-October; also scored at Nottingham in October, a runaway win over 2m2f on heavy going which sees him 2lb higher today; returned to form when third over 2m at Musselburgh three weeks ago but this C&D makes him look vulnerable.

17:15.race_name: Sky Bet Build A Bet Handicap

runners.comment: Nine course wins; whether he has the toe for 5f, at his age off this mark, is the question
runners.name: Jordan Electrics
runners.owner: B Jordan Brian Jordan S Jordan & N McConnell
runners.spotlight: Nine course wins to his name from 22 starts here (3-7 over C&D); in good form of late, having spent last year in the grip of the handicapper, but that was over 7f and whether he still has the toe for 5f, at his age off this mark, is the question; yard also runs Woohoo.

runners.comment: In good form; little wiggle room off this mark and he'll need a career best if he's to win
runners.name: Master Of My Fate
runners.owner: Ms Janelle Cao Ross Harmon & Partner
runners.spotlight: Most wins have come on the AW but he is fine on turf (2-11) and turned in another in-form effort at Nottingham three weeks ago; there's little wiggle room off this mark (3lb above his highest successful rating) and he'll need a career best if he's to win.

runners.comment: As good as ever on Tapeta lately; returns to turf 3lb above his highest winning mark
runners.name: Spring Is Sprung
runners.spotlight: As good as ever on Tapeta lately, albeit turned over as favourite on last two outings; returns to turf 3lb above his highest winning mark and at the age of seven (no surprise to see Rhys Elliott up to take off 5lb) and he will need to get things bang on.

runners.comment: Well held on his AW comeback early last month and may need some help from the handicapper
runners.name: Marty Hopkirk
runners.spotlight: Looked flattered from the front in a small field on his handicap debut last July, since when he's struggled; well held on his Southwell comeback (won his novice on Tapeta) early last month and may need some help from the handicapper.

runners.comment: Patchy last season and more of the same this term; hard to know what to expect
runners.name: Vantheman
runners.spotlight: Patchy last season and more of the same this term, failing to build on a Tapeta win off 3lb lower in three runs since; latest effort in first-time blinkers is readily ignored but it's hard to know what to expect for a yard also responsible for Mon Na Slieve.

runners.comment: 2lb rise puts him on a career-high mark into a more competitive handicap, down from 6f
runners.name: Station X
runners.spotlight: Turf wins as a 2yo came on soft/heavy ground and the midweek rain will have helped, although he'd have preferred more; highly consistent but a 2lb rise for his recent AW win puts him on a career-high mark into a more competitive handicap, down from 6f.

runners.comment: Entitled to have needed his recent comeback from nine months off; first run over 5f
runners.name: Alpha Magic
runners.spotlight: His two wins came on good to soft ground over 6f, including here off this mark last June; entitled to have needed his recent comeback from nine months off, when leading for a long way, and he's low mileage compared to most of these; first run over 5f.

runners.comment: Won from the rail draw at Ripon and a 6lb rise looks plenty as he goes back up in class
runners.name: Vince LAmour
runners.spotlight: Wins have all come over easy tracks in the spring/autumn on good or softer ground; won well at Ripon last weekend but was always well positioned from the rail draw and a 6lb rise looks plenty as he goes back up in class.

runners.comment: Inconsistent front-runner; on a competitive mark if he's on a going day though
runners.name: Mon Na Slieve
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent front-runner who's given a third try in a tongue-tie following a below-par effort back on turf last time (made much of the running from the rail draw at Musselburgh); on a competitive mark if he's on a going day though.

runners.comment: 2lb below his last successful mark and has won here before; David Allan on Vince L'Amour
runners.name: Manila Scouse
runners.spotlight: May have needed his recent comeback from six months off at his age (cracked late on having raced prominently from a low stall over 6f round Chester); 2lb below his last successful mark and has won here before but David Allan has opted for Vince L'Amour.

runners.comment: C&D winner who boasts a good record at this time of year; not much luck lately; player
runners.name: Reigning Profit
runners.spotlight: C&D winner who boasts a good record at this time of year; will always be reliant on some luck given his hold-up style, which he hasn't had this year; on a handy mark when things do fall his way again, though, and is one to consider.

runners.comment: Progressive in lesser company last summer; can have issues at the stalls; needs better
runners.name: Azuinthejungle
runners.owner: D P Van Der Hoeven & D G Pryde
runners.spotlight: Progressive in lesser company last summer, when completing a hat-trick, latterly off 6lb lower; excuses subsequently, including when getting upset in the stalls (not for the first time) on his comeback behind two of these three weeks ago.

runners.comment: Has done most racing over further; the early impact of the visor may have worn off now
runners.name: Pal Joey
runners.spotlight: Found a Newcastle handicap run to suit when winning over this trip in January but has otherwise done most racing over further; the early impact of the visor may have worn off now and he was inclined to pull hard when well held back on turf a month ago.

runners.comment: Won four early last summer, including over C&D, and again at Musselburgh on latest start
runners.name: Woohoo
runners.spotlight: Won four times early last summer, including over C&D, and climbed 19lb up the weights; made it three wins and a second in four starts under Lauren Young when turning in a career-best effort to score at Musselburgh last time out and may well be up to defying a 3lb rise.

runners.comment: Three wins this year, including last time, but has first run in higher than 0-65 company
runners.name: Little Mi Mi
runners.owner: N Irving F Steele & I Jardine
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish mare who's won three this year, proving at Ayr last time that she can do it on turf as well as Tapeta; upped another 5lb, though, and this is the first time she's run in higher than 0-65 company; not ruled out but she'll find this opposition tougher.

17:45.race_name: Sky Bet Price Boosts Fillies' Handicap

runners.comment: Too free when beating one home on stable debut at Goodwood; she's the sort to bounce back
runners.name: Crystal Flyer
runners.owner: Castle Racing Co Ltd & Mps Racing Ltd
runners.spotlight: Consistent for Tom Ward in 2025; changed hands for 70,000gns but she went too freely when beating only one home on her stable debut in a 1m4f Listed event at Goodwood on her recent return; she's the sort to bounce back.

runners.comment: Progressed well in 2025 until 13th at Saint-Cloud; appeals as the sort to do well in 2026
runners.name: Seren Star
runners.spotlight: Progressed well in 2025 (a three-time winner around 1m) until hooded and only 13th in Saint-Cloud Listed event (1m) on her final run in November; headgear is quickly dispensed with and she appeals as the sort to do well again in 2026.

runners.comment: In winning hurdling form over winter for current yard; not out of things back on Flat
runners.name: Azahara Palace
runners.spotlight: A fair 1m4f scorer for Hughie Morrison who showed winning hurdling form over the winter for her current yard; not out of things back in this sphere with a visor added.

runners.comment: Back on track for current yard with Haydock third 22 days ago; needs considering
runners.name: Cancelled
runners.spotlight: A fair 9.5f winner in Ireland; got back on track for her current yard with third of eight in 1m2f Haydock handicap 22 days ago; needs considering off an easing mark.

runners.comment: C&D scorer; in decent nick, fourth at Musselburgh latest; 2lb out of handicap though
runners.name: Epidavros
runners.spotlight: On a losing run but this C&D scorer comes here in decent nick, fourth of 12 in 1m1f Musselburgh handicap three weeks ago; 2lb out of the handicap here though.

runners.comment: Enjoyed a superb 2025 when a six-time winner (including here) but yet to fire this season
runners.name: Second Fiddle
runners.spotlight: Enjoyed a superb 2025 when a six-time winner (including here) but yet to fire this season, beating just one home in a 1m Musselburgh handicap last month; she's 4lb out of the handicap too.

runners.comment: Good fourth in Beverley handicap 13 days ago; in the mix off an unchanged mark
runners.name: Dunkeld Dreamer
runners.spotlight: Resumed winning ways at Haydock (1m) in April and she backed it up with a good fourth of nine in 7.5f Beverley handicap 13 days ago; in the mix off an unchanged mark.

runners.comment: Improving filly; second in Kempton handicap in March; big shout nudged up 1lb
runners.name: Plaid
runners.spotlight: Has improved a chunk with each of her three runs, landing 1m Kempton novice in December before returning with a neck second of six in 1m handicap there in March; big shout back from a break nudged up just 1lb.

18:15.race_name: Sky Bet For The Fans Handicap

runners.comment: Had a rare off-day at Thirsk a fortnight ago but is quite capable of bouncing back
runners.name: Aberama Gold
runners.spotlight: Getting on but retains a lot of his old ability, is still consistent enough and has won over C&D before; rare off-day at Thirsk a fortnight ago, having beating a subsequent winner in a small field off 1lb lower previously; quite capable of bouncing back.

runners.comment: A good test over this trip is fine; at his best last year around this time; player
runners.name: Jonny Concrete
runners.spotlight: Stays 1m and two of his three wins came over 7f but a good test over this trip is fine; at his best last year around this time and resumed with a solid effort as favourite at Chester nine days ago (behind The Good Biscuit); will rightly be popular.

runners.comment: No worries about the return to 6f in another big field and may yet be capable of better
runners.name: Montezuma
runners.owner: B Jordan Brian Jordan S Jordan & N McConnell
runners.spotlight: Three solid efforts over 5f at Musselburgh this spring; no worries about the return to 6f in another big field and he may yet be capable of better; high on the shortlist.

runners.breeder: Executors Of The Late Mr J L C Pearce
runners.comment: Not as good now but enjoying a consistent spring; no obvious reason he won't go well again
runners.name: Juan Les Pins
runners.spotlight: Not as good now but enjoying a highly consistent spring, finishing a clear second off a 2lb lower mark at Ascot last weekend; no obvious reason he won't go well once more.

runners.comment: Unlucky not to finish closer behind two of these at Chester; holds each-way claims
runners.name: Secret Guest
runners.spotlight: Only won one of his last 28 starts but has slid to a competitive mark as a result and was unlucky not to finish closer behind The Good Biscuit and Jonny Concrete at Chester (hampered late); holds each-way claims.

runners.comment: Resumed in good form off his revised mark; adaptable and can't be discounted
runners.name: The Good Biscuit
runners.spotlight: Closed out last season with a pair of soft-ground wins and has resumed in good form off his revised mark, latterly when having two of these behind at Chester last weekend; adaptable as regards ground and tactics, and can't be discounted.

runners.comment: Resumes from five months off 2lb above her last winning mark; bit to overcome
runners.name: Mae Amor
runners.spotlight: Struggled in three runs after joining from David O'Meara last autumn and resumes from five months off 2lb above her last winning mark; bit to overcome against some in-form, race-fit rivals.

runners.comment: Fair record here for the Quinn yard; will need to be spot on back from six months off
runners.name: Top Juggler
runners.spotlight: Fair record here for the Quinn yard; made a successful debut for his current trainer off 2lb lower last September but will need to be spot on as he returns from more than six months off.

runners.breeder: Skymarch Farm Inc & Ecurie Des Charmes
runners.comment: Wants a good test at this trip; said to have run flat last time; 2-4 for Kaiya Fraser
runners.name: Abduction
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D off this mark last summer but does most racing now over further and wants a good test at this trip; said to have run flat last time but does have his good and bad days now for a yard responsible for two others; 2-4 for Kaiya Fraser.

runners.comment: Decent second on the AW last time, but he's far from certain to repeat the effort
runners.name: Lions House
runners.spotlight: Wins have all come on Tapeta and does most racing now at Newcastle; decent second there last time, back up from 5f, but this is stronger and he's far from certain to repeat the effort.

runners.comment: Resumed in decent form; holds each-way claims but this is a stronger race than last time
runners.name: Rock Opera
runners.spotlight: Winless in two years but has slid to a handy mark and resumed in decent form; holds each-way claims but this is a stronger race than the Thirsk handicap in which he was a bit unlucky not to finish closer last time.

runners.comment: Twice been unlucky in big-field Thirsk handicaps this spring; enters calculations
runners.name: Stirrup Cup
runners.spotlight: Soft-ground C&D winner last autumn who's twice been unlucky in big-field Thirsk handicaps switched to cheekpieces this spring; better off with Juan Les Pins than on his comeback and enters calculations.

runners.comment: Said to have hung left when well beaten on his return to turf seven weeks ago; outsider
runners.name: Beauty Choice
runners.spotlight: Winless since 2024 and winless in sprints since 2023; said to have hung left when well beaten on his return to turf seven weeks ago and only holds outside claims.

runners.comment: Prolific winner down the years but has his quirks and is hard to catch right now
runners.name: Water Of Leith
runners.owner: Adam Mills And Jonnie Delta Racing
runners.spotlight: Prolific winner down the years but has his quirks and is hard to catch right now; the return to 6f won't hurt and he's quite capable if everything falls right, but Montezuma looks his trainer's best chance (also runs Abduction).

runners.breeder: J Hanly Castlemartin Sky & Skymarc Far
runners.comment: Regressive maiden who returns from seven months off; would be a surprise winner
runners.name: Who Wants Me
runners.spotlight: Regressive maiden who returns from seven months off having undergone a second round of wind surgery; done a lot of her racing over 7f and she'd be a surprise winner for a yard that has more obvious claims with Jonny Concrete.

18:45.race_name: Flutter Proud To Support Young Lives Vs Cancer Apprentice Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.comment: Can show up well again after his two big runs at Musselburgh, pipped by Letsbefrank latest
runners.name: Fast Fred
runners.spotlight: Dependable sort who's been in career-best form with a win and two seconds this season; raised another 2lb but can show up well again after his two big runs at Musselburgh (pipped by Letsbefrank latest); highly respected.

runners.comment: He'll need better than he's produced this season but is back to his last winning mark
runners.name: LEagle Aid
runners.spotlight: Usually races prominently but came from the rear, having fluffed the start, for one of his two 1m4f wins last summer; he'll need better than he's produced this season but is back to his last winning mark.

runners.comment: 1m3f Flat and 2m hurdle wins initially for G Cromwell; could have more to offer on Flat
runners.name: Secret Force
runners.spotlight: 1m3f Flat and 2m hurdle wins last autumn on first two runs for Gavin Cromwell but pulled up one month ago on handicap hurdle debut when wearing tongue-strap and cheekpieces for the first time; the latter are not retained on this first run for new yard (same owner); could have more to offer on Flat.

runners.comment: Very late on the scene at 20-1 to deny Fast Fred at Musselburgh (1m4f); player back up 4lb
runners.name: Letsbefrank
runners.spotlight: Three wins (C&D, 1m6f and 2m1f) in summer 2024 and, from a reduced mark, back on the scoresheet  at Musselburgh (1m4f) three weeks ago when arriving very late on the scene at 20-1 under Lauren Young to deny Fast Fred; back up 4lb but could take another step back up the ladder.

runners.breeder: His Highness The Aga Khans Studs S C
runners.comment: 0-7 in Ireland and 4th of six last June on her only start for current yard; none too solid
runners.name: Kisiyra
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden when trained by Johnny Murtagh in Ireland, placed twice as a 2yo; sold for 3,000euros in November 2024 but had only one run for current yard, when fourth of six at Thirsk (1m4f) last June; not beaten far that day but others bring more solid claims.

runners.comment: Rethink on trip but a C&D third last June and 1m2f win last September are encouraging
runners.name: Izzari
runners.spotlight: Raced at 1m this season, for a good fourth on reappearance but well-beaten second favourite here next time; this is a rethink on trip but a C&D third last June and 1m2f win last September are encouraging.

runners.comment: 11-race maiden; has tried cheekpieces and now has tongue tied for step up in trip
runners.name: Polygram
runners.spotlight: Went close more than once for Harry Charlton but left that yard an eight-race maiden and she's not threatened to put that right in three runs for new yard; has tried cheekpieces and now has tongue tied for step up in trip.

runners.comment: Behind on both runs (1m4f; 25-1 and 28-1) for new yard, so seems best watched for now
runners.name: Furhaan
runners.spotlight: Won handicap debut at Windsor (heavy) in September and creditable fifth at Yarmouth (good) next time, both over an extended 1m3f; left Ed Walker for 32,000gns later in October and behind on both runs (1m4f; 25-1 and 28-1) this season, so seems best watched for now.

runners.comment: Not that consistent but won twice last summer; no show at 33-1 for recent return in a hood
runners.name: Sure And Stedfast
runners.spotlight: Can get a bit worked up and not that consistent but he still won last summer at Ayr (1m2f) and Carlisle (1m1f) and ran creditably over 1m4f on final outing; no show at 33-1 for recent reappearance when a hood was enlisted, which it isn't today; competitive if this is one of his good days.

runners.comment: Three wins last August/September; needs respect if tuned up for this reappearance
runners.name: Sweet Kiss
runners.spotlight: Won three times over 1m2f under 7lb claimer Jake Dickson last August/September; progressive overall in that campaign and needs respect if she's sufficiently tuned up for this reappearance; market may guide.

runners.comment: 4-27 at Hamilton; respectable return to Flat over C&D two weeks ago under Lexie Clarkson
runners.name: Jaminoz
runners.spotlight: 4-27 at Hamilton, which has dominated his itinerary but he also has two wins elsewhere; made a respectable return to Flat over C&D two weeks ago under Lexie Clarkson and could build on that to get seriously involved.

runners.comment: 1m2f/1m4f AW wins and better still when scoring over 1m1f at Musselburgh three weeks ago
runners.name: Krissy
runners.spotlight: There was an extraordinary turnaround in her fortunes late last year and she was better still when winning from the front in a 12-runner race at Musselburgh (1m1f, good) on return to turf three weeks ago; with earlier AW wins over 1m2f and 1m4f, this step back up in trip does not look a worry and going up another 4lb may also be manageable; major player.

14:17.race_name: Anglo Stainless Supporting Yorkshire Wooden Spoon Apprentice Handicap

runners.comment: 33-1 outsider of five for Thirsk 1m6f win; back up just 2lb and return to 2m may well suit
runners.name: Scottish Dancer
runners.spotlight: Lost his way in Ireland last year as a hurdler but, having first Flat run since June 2023, made a winning start from the front for new yard in handicap at Thirsk (1m6f, good to firm) 15 days ago; the big outsider of five that day and dictated a slow pace, but he's gone back up by just 2lb and the return to 2m may well suit him; major player in bid to win a second time under Millie Wonnacott.

runners.comment: Ready winner at Bath (2m1f) and good second over C&D (good) eight days later; player
runners.name: No More Bolero
runners.spotlight: Ready winner at Bath (2m1f, good to firm) on reappearance and good second under Mason Paetel over C&D (good) eight days later; another bold bid looks on its way.

runners.comment: Stays 2m and he's a player if transferring this year's AW improvement back to turf
runners.name: Trojan Soldier
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in four of his first five handicaps before finally cracking it in a four-runner race at Southwell (1m6f, AW) in April; that was in first-time cheekpieces (retained) but by just a nose, leading on the post; stays 2m and he's a player if transferring this year's improvement back to turf.

runners.comment: Had a good 2025; this year's return was downbeat affair behind Scottish Dancer 15 days ago
runners.name: Marbuzet
runners.spotlight: Had a good 2025, winning over 1m7f at Ayr (good to firm) and 2m at Chester (good); also runner-up on five occasions, including here (short-headed) and on his reappearance, but this year's return was a downbeat affair behind Scottish Dancer 15 days ago.

runners.comment: Has another career-low mark but it's hard to know when he will take advantage
runners.name: Vaguely Royal
runners.spotlight: There was some restoration of his Flat fortunes when third of five at Southwell (1m6f, AW; stays 2m) on latest start but he's without a win on the Flat since the end of 2023; has another career-low mark but it's hard to know when he will take advantage.

runners.comment: Cheekpieces return and stepping back up in trip should suit, so he needs a close look
runners.name: Elemental Eye
runners.spotlight: Winner at Redcar (2m, good to soft) and Musselburgh (1m6f, soft; by 10l) last term; not disgraced back on Flat at Newcastle (1m4f) in March; cheekpieces get their first airing since October and stepping back up in trip should suit, so he needs a close look.

runners.comment: Fair third over C&D on his only Flat run this year and peak form gives him a good shout
runners.name: Rupert The Prince
runners.spotlight: Won three times (once from rear, twice making all) at up to 2m last term on the Flat for Paddy Butler; remote this year in his two hurdle races (three-runner race last time) but he was a fair third over C&D (a head behind No More Bolero) in between and peak form gives him a good shout.

14:47.race_name: Paul Hammond Associates Celebrating Yorkshire Spoon EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Beaten at odds-on at Thirsk on debut (5f, good) four weeks ago; surely capable of better
runners.name: Bai Tong
runners.spotlight: Sent off the 8-11 favourite for her Thirsk debut (5f, good) four weeks ago but dropped away to finish fifth of the sixth runners; that form has been franked since and she should be capable of better; interesting to see if her backers return.

runners.comment: Redcar debut effort was quite promising but she'll need a good step forward; yard runs two
runners.name: Cheeky Chesca
runners.spotlight: 40-1 for her Redcar debut four weeks ago (5f, good to firm), a race where she showed both ability and inexperience; stable also responsible for Fern Clyde.

runners.comment: Hung left on both starts, including when favourite latest; can do better at some point
runners.name: Crimson Blaze
runners.spotlight: She hasn't lived up to her market billing in two 5f runs on AW, hanging left on debut and again at Southwell 18 days ago when Oisin Murphy allowed her to come home in her own time once her chance had gone; should do better at some point and at least she'll have a rail to help if she hangs today.

runners.comment: Dam a 5f Listed winner as a 2yo; the only newcomer in the field; betting to guide
runners.name: Eevee Star
runners.spotlight: February foal by Showcasing; second foal of a 5f 2yo winner (including Listed; RPR 95); betting to guide for a stable with an 11% strike-rate with juveniles.

runners.comment: In need of experience when midfield on Beverley debut; open to improvement; yard runs two
runners.name: Fern Clyde
runners.spotlight: Seemed to need the outing/experience at Beverley (5f, good to soft) last month when finishing sixth; open to improvement; stable also runs Cheeky Chesca.

runners.comment: Down the field at Beverley on recent debut (33-1); a big step forward is required
runners.name: Spirit Of Mary
runners.spotlight: Down the field in a Beverley maiden 13 days ago (5f, good to soft; 33-1); a big step forward is required.

runners.comment: Finished in front of Fern Clyde at Beverley on debut; 6f should suit; can do better
runners.name: The Can Can Queen
runners.spotlight: Outpaced in the closing stages when fifth of 11 on her Beverley debut last month (5f, good to soft; finished 1.25l in front of Fern Clyde); open to improvement and her stable took this prize in 2024.

runners.comment: Didn't live up to market billing on Musselburgh debut six weeks ago; can do better at 6f
runners.name: Tricky Jenny
runners.spotlight: 5-1 third favourite for her debut at Musselburgh last month (5f, soft), a race where she showed speed before weakening quickly inside the final furlong; should last longer today but she will need a jolt of improvement.

15:17.race_name: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Handicap

runners.comment: Showed improved form when beaten a neck on his handicap debut at Pontefract last month.
runners.name: Finlaggan
runners.spotlight: Ex-French; showed much improved form up in distance when beaten a neck on his handicap debut at Pontefract (1m2f, good) last month; with a shrewd outfit and should be hard to beat.

runners.comment: Always in rear when last of six on stable debut at Newcastle in December.
runners.name: Popeye Doyle
runners.spotlight: Won twice around 1m on AW for Hugo Palmer last summer; always in rear when last of six on stable debut at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) in December; has work to do back on turf.

runners.comment: Has shown modest form in three runs over hurdles since his last Flat race last October.
runners.name: Twilight Safari
runners.spotlight: Yet to win under rules; has shown modest form in three runs over hurdles since his last race on the Flat last October; hard to fancy.

runners.comment: Best run on turf when third at Haydock last September off 6lb lower.
runners.name: Everyoneknowsadave
runners.spotlight: All three wins on AW between 7f-1m3f; best run on turf when third of 11 at Haydock (1m3f, good) last September off 6lb lower; first-time cheekpieces worn last time are dispensed with; down to a career-low mark and not out of this.

runners.comment: Has made the frame back on turf on his last two starts and holds place claims once again.
runners.name: Bearwith
runners.spotlight: Grand stable servant who wins in his turn; successful at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) in February and has made the frame back on turf on his last two starts; place claims once again.

runners.breeder: Poppy Holdings Ltd & West Shaw Farm Ltd
runners.comment: 0-7 under rules but made the frame four times for Ed Bethell in 2024.
runners.name: Skinny Malinka
runners.spotlight: 0-7 under rules but made the frame four times for Ed Bethell in 2024; pulled up on his hurdles debut on first start for this yard in December 2024 and has been absent since; best watched for now.

runners.comment: Took advantage of a reduced mark to make a winning reappearance at Newcastle last month.
runners.name: The Cookstown Cafu
runners.spotlight: All six wins have been over 7f-1m; took advantage of a reduced mark to make a winning reappearance at Newcastle (1m, AW) last month; steps up in trip off 5lb higher on his return to turf; still well treated on his old form and cannot be discounted.

runners.comment: Won for the first time since August 2023 in a weak contest at Musselburgh last month.
runners.name: Spirit Catcher
runners.spotlight: Won for the first time since August 2023 off a much reduced mark in a weak contest at Musselburgh (1m1f, good) last month; not sure to back that up in this better contest off 4lb higher.

runners.comment: Has nine career wins but has been operating below his best for some time; best watched.
runners.name: Distinction
runners.spotlight: Nine career wins but operating below his best for some time; best watched.

runners.breeder: Mrs J K Powell & Catridge Farm Stud
runners.comment: Grand veteran striving to maintain his record of winning every year since 2017.
runners.name: Poets Dawn
runners.spotlight: Grand veteran striving to maintain his record of winning at least once every year since 2017; not the force of old and although he is down to a career-low mark, this looks a tad too competitive for him nowadays.

runners.comment: Three-timer last August; down the field at Doncaster and Nottingham this year.
runners.name: Bay Dream Believer
runners.spotlight: Rattled off a three-timer last August (two of which were over C&D); yet to get going this year, down the field at Doncaster and Nottingham; now 2lb lower than her last winning mark but doesn't look ready to take advantage.

runners.comment: 0-11; hasn't built on his early promise when third on his debut here in August 2024.
runners.name: Off Spin
runners.owner: S Bulmer P Hebdon & R Taylor
runners.spotlight: 0-11; hasn't built on his early promise when third on his debut here in August 2024; his mark continues to drop but he doesn't appeal.

runners.comment: Both wins came when trained in France; yet to be placed in 14 starts for current yard.
runners.name: Speechman
runners.spotlight: Both wins came when trained in France; yet to be placed in 14 starts for current yard; makes seasonal debut and hard to enthuse about.

runners.comment: 2-41 but didn't fare too badly when sixth on his return to action over C&D nine days ago.
runners.name: Tiberio Force
runners.owner: Maj Green S Croft & S Whitaker
runners.spotlight: 2-41 but didn't fare too badly when sixth of 12 on his return to action over C&D (good) nine days ago; 1lb wrong in the weights but offers more than many others here.

runners.comment: Of interest on 2025 best but yet to shine this spring; headgear now reached for
runners.name: Beaujolais Nouveau
runners.spotlight: Ran well when third in a 7f handicap at Thirsk last September and she is now 5lb lower; two disappointing efforts last month and she now has cheekpieces fitted; eased in grade but others look more persuasive.

runners.comment: Three wins as a 2yo; low-key seasonal return; eased in class but has a point to prove
runners.name: Lebron Power
runners.spotlight: Won three times as a 2yo (5f and 6f, soft and good to firm); disappointing run on her seasonal debut at Newmarket last month; this is weaker but she will need a career best.

runners.comment: Near miss at Lingfield (7f, AW) in February; respectable 3rds on last two runs; e-w shout
runners.name: Powdering
runners.spotlight: As good as ever as a 6yo judged on her near miss at Lingfield (7f, AW); latest Newmarket third probably not the run to judge her on and she can't be ruled out, for all stall 1 isn't ideal.

runners.breeder: Hellwood Stud Farm & G P Clarke
runners.comment: Back to form with close second at Yarmouth (7f, good) 19 days ago; leading claims
runners.name: Shallow
runners.spotlight: Game effort to win a Newmarket handicap (6f, good to firm) last July and she is now 4lb lower; bounced back from some modest efforts when just missing out in a 7f handicap at Yarmouth 19 days ago (good ground; cheekpieces first time), pulling clear with a mare who has since run well in a Group 3; might not have to work too hard to get the stands' rail and she looks to hold strong claims.

runners.comment: 3-5 on turf for Julie Camacho, the latest a 5f success at Pontefract; can go well again
runners.name: Alpine Girl
runners.spotlight: Good record on turf for new yard, winning cosily at Pontefract 18 days ago (5f, good); a 5lb rise shouldn't prevent another good run.

runners.comment: Two wins last year, notably a C&D Listed in August; can step up on this year's two runs
runners.name: Anaisa
runners.spotlight: Won twice as a 2yo, notably a Listed success over C&D last August; life has been tougher since but both this year's runs have been creditable; proven course form and the stands' rail draw will count for plenty and she's one to consider.

runners.comment: Began 2026 with two AW wins; unplaced but not disgraced twice since; can't rule out
runners.name: Saffron Dandy
runners.spotlight: Won her first two handicaps, both over 6f on AW this winter; she has come up short in good handicaps on her last two starts but she is back against her own sex this afternoon and isn't impossibly treated if the cards drop right for her.

runners.comment: Two wins as a 2yo; down the field over C&D on her reappearance; others better treated
runners.name: Cotai Belle
runners.spotlight: Two wins last summer, a 5.5f maiden at Wetherby (good to firm) and a 5f nursery at Haydock (good), before coming up short in two sales races and the Listed Two-Year-Old Trophy; never dangerous in a C&D handicap on last month's return to action; others look better treated.

runners.comment: Arrives in good form but this is a step up in class and she may come up short
runners.name: Space Bear
runners.spotlight: Ran out the comfortable winner of a 6f handicap at Yarmouth last month but she was unable to build on it at Kempton nine days later; steps up in class this time.

16:20.race_name: On-Course Bookmakers Welcome You To Ripon Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Dropped away to finish last of ten on last month's Nottingham debut; longer-term prospect
runners.name: Sweet Desire
runners.spotlight: 50-1 when dropping away to finish last of ten on her Nottingham debut last month (6f, good); looks a longer-term prospect.

runners.comment: 420,000gns yearling with fine sprinting pedigree; starts out in a winnable race; contender
runners.name: Black Orchid
runners.spotlight: 420,000gns yearling; fifth foal; half-sister to winners Motorious (5f-7f including US turf Grade 2; RPR 123), Matters Most (5f/6f including Hong Kong; 102), Topwarrior (6f; 98) and Haymaker (5f-7f; 97); dam Group-placed 6f AW 2yo winner (103); she doesn't have a daunting standard to aim at on debut and needs a close market check.

runners.comment: Well-beaten last of four on debut at Pontefract (6f, good); big leap forward required
runners.name: Elemma
runners.spotlight: Weak in the betting when finishing a well-beaten last of four on her Pontefract debut (6f, good) last month; she will need to leave that well behind her to feature; stable also runs Black Orchid.

runners.comment: Half-sister to two winners, notably the useful Kynren (RPR 112); betting should guide
runners.name: Kyrenia
runners.spotlight: Fifth foal; half-sister to winners Kynren (7f/1m; RPR 112) and Gentle Ellen (6f; 78); dam unplaced 7f-1m6f (45); only of interest if attracting market support.

runners.comment: Never in the hunt at Doncaster three weeks ago (5f, good to firm); difficult to recommend
runners.name: Lady Grey
runners.spotlight: Always in rear when beaten 24l on her Doncaster debut three weeks ago (5f, good to firm); attracted some support at big prices on that occasion but she is not easily recommended here.

runners.comment: Modest form in two runs 387 days apart; minor handicaps beckon
runners.name: Sparkling Wine
runners.spotlight: Sent off at big prices and has run to just a modest level in her two starts 387 days apart, the latest over C&D nine days ago; should find easier pickings once handicapping.

runners.comment: Similar form in three maiden/novice runs as a 2yo; sets a clear standard back from a break
runners.name: Zen Diva
runners.spotlight: Expensive to follow as a 2yo, beaten favourite in both runs following her promising Newbury debut (6f, good); sets a clear form standard on her return from a 227-day absence; cheekpieces now reached for.

runners.comment: Half-sister to a 1m4f winner out of a 1m2f winner; starts out at a realistic level
runners.name: Ziggy Bay
runners.spotlight: Fifth foal; half-sister to 1m4f winner Ricardo Phillips (RPR 60); dam 1m2f winner (52), half-sister to Stewards' Cup winner Gift Horse and 6f-7f winner Peggy Spencer (dam of Nunthorpe winner La Cucaracha); tongue tied for debut; won't have to be a star to be involved so worth a market check.

16:50.race_name: Swinton Park Silver Anniversary Cup Handicap

runners.comment: Ended 2025 with victory at Newcastle in September but he's yet to fire this spring.
runners.name: Daring Leader
runners.owner: D J Jones & M T Brougham
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with victory at Newcastle (1m2f) in September but he's yet to fire this spring, only eighth in 9.5f Wolverhampton handicap last month; needs to take a big step forward despite a slipping mark.

runners.comment: Won four times on Newcastle AW in 2024 but winless since.
runners.name: Barleybrown
runners.spotlight: Won four times on Newcastle AW in 2024 but winless since; needs to be held up off a strong pace but not really firing at present.

runners.comment: Kept on well on his last two starts at Beverley over 8.5f and a step up in trip may suit.
runners.name: Woodleigh
runners.spotlight: Scored off this mark at Redcar (1m2f, good to soft) last October; kept on well on his last two starts at Beverley over 8.5f suggesting that a step back up in trip may be beneficial.

runners.comment: Got off the mark at Beverley last June but last of ten back there last month.
runners.name: Quirke On Parole
runners.owner: A Quirke & Mrs G B Walford
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm) last June; last of ten back there (8.5f) on reappearance last month but should strip fitter here and not out of this.

runners.comment: Has three course wins over 1m2f; hasn't figured since returning to turf last month.
runners.name: Little Ted
runners.spotlight: Has three course wins over 1m2f; hasn't figured at Redcar or Ayr since returning to turf last month; best watched.

runners.comment: Landed a brace at Ayr and Nottingham around 1m last October on heavy.
runners.name: Oilisa
runners.spotlight: Landed a brace at Ayr and Nottingham around 1m last October on heavy; still lightly raced and should be better for the run when tenth of 22 in amateurs' handicap at Doncaster (1m, good to soft) in March; one to keep an eye on.

runners.comment: Usually ridden with hold-up tactics and will need plenty of luck in running.
runners.name: Balqaa
runners.spotlight: All five wins have came on AW; usually ridden with hold-up tactics and will need plenty of luck in running to get her head in front here.

runners.comment: Has four wins on Newcastle AW but is only 1-19 on turf.
runners.name: Volenti
runners.spotlight: Has four wins on Newcastle AW but is only 1-19 on turf; never figured on return to turf when seventh of nine at Pontefract (1m, good) in cheekpieces (left off here) last month; needs to show more.

runners.comment: Last of four wins on turf came in August 2021 but won on Southwell AW in March.
runners.name: Arranmore
runners.spotlight: Last of four wins on turf came in August 2021 but he's been in good order on AW recently, winning at Southwell (1m3f) in March; not sure that the drop back in trip will suit on this return to turf.

runners.comment: Has failed to deliver in handicaps since landing a Catterick novice in May 2025.
runners.name: Far Ahead
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd
runners.spotlight: Has failed to deliver in handicaps since landing a Catterick novice in May 2025; his mark continues to plummet but he needs to show more.

runners.comment: Has ran well in classifieds on AW this year, winning one at Newcastle in February.
runners.name: I Can Boogy
runners.spotlight: Has run well in classifieds on AW this year, winning such an event at Newcastle (1m) in February, but has not been as good in a couple of handicaps; well handicapped on her best turf form.

runners.comment: 0-21 on turf and has dropped to a career-low mark; doesn't appeal for win purposes.
runners.name: Ring Of Gold
runners.spotlight: All five wins over 7f on AW; 0-21 on turf and doesn't appeal for win purposes despite career-low mark.

runners.comment: 1-23 but ran well on her reappearance when third of ten at Nottingham last month.
runners.name: Haaf A Diamond
runners.owner: Dr M Voikhansky & Mrs S Voikhanskaya
runners.spotlight: 1-23 but ran well on her reappearance when third of ten at Nottingham (8.5f, good) last month in first-time cheekpieces (retained since); not so good when sixth of 11 at Southwell (1m, AW) since but holds claims if she can run to her best.

runners.breeder: Hellwood Stud Farm & G P Clarke
runners.comment: 26-race maiden; two poor efforts on turf this year; easy to dismiss.
runners.name: Penny Ghent
runners.spotlight: 26-race maiden; two poor efforts on turf this year; easy to dismiss.

runners.comment: Well backed when making a winning h'cap debut at Hamilton two weeks ago; big player up 3lb
runners.name: Simbas Pride
runners.spotlight: Showed promise in maiden/novice company at Thirsk (5f to 1m) and he duly stepped forward on his handicap debut at Hamilton two weeks ago (6f, good), always prominent and proving too strong for the reopposing Ellie's De Vega; attracted market support on that occasion (14-1 into 15-2) and he looks a major player up 3lb.

runners.comment: 6f AW win last month before finding 5f too sharp latest; still in form; each-way shout
runners.name: Pivotal Terms
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark at the ninth time of asking when leading late in a 6f handicap at Newcastle five weeks ago; inconvenienced by dropping to 5f at Musselburgh next time but ran well enough to think she was still in form; not handicapped out of things.

runners.comment: 0-10 but four times a runner-up, including on seasonal return; in the mix once more
runners.name: Gunalt Wavelength
runners.spotlight: Ten-race maiden but she has finished second on four occasions, including her seasonal return four weeks ago (6f, good to firm; handles soft); runs off the same mark and holds each-way claims once again.

runners.comment: Front-runner; two solid efforts in 6f h'caps this year; closely matched with Simba's Pride
runners.name: Ellies de Vega
runners.spotlight: Front-runner; two solid third-place finishes in 6f handicaps this spring, shaping second best behind Simba's Pride at Hamilton a fortnight ago (bit short of room and lost second close home); 3lb turnaround in the weights may be insufficient.

runners.comment: Finished last in two handicap runs this spring; down in weights but with a point to prove
runners.name: Peggy Boo
runners.owner: S Ullyott T Coyle & P Robinson
runners.spotlight: Signs of ability in three 2yo runs but she has finished last in her two sprint handicap runs this year (6f, AW and 5f, good); dropping down the weights but she has a point to prove.

runners.comment: No improvement for handicapping when 7th at Doncaster (7f) 15 days ago; yard runs two here
runners.name: Vegas Virtue
runners.spotlight: No immediate improvement for the switch to handicaps when seventh of nine, beaten just over 4l, in a 7f event at Doncaster a fortnight ago; still has time to do better but Hares Bredth may prove the stable's main hope.

runners.comment: Not ideally positioned when third of 14 at Redcar ten days ago; still capable of better
runners.name: Hares Bredth
runners.spotlight: Ran his best race to date when keeping on for third in a 0-55 handicap at Redcar ten days ago (6f, good), racing further away from the stands' rail than the pair to beat him; still has some potential in minor sprint handicaps and he is more appealing than many.

runners.comment: Chance on his Beverley fourth last August but he has been well beaten in three runs since
runners.name: Tenors Inn
runners.spotlight: Ran well at Beverley (5f, good to firm) last August, beaten under one length into fourth in a nursery off an 8lb higher mark than today's; no progress since and he needs to leave his reappearance effort well behind him.

runners.comment: Modest form in six AW runs; needs improvement for the switch to turf
runners.name: What A Tahoo
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd
runners.spotlight: She has run to a modest level in her six starts on AW, showing best form when fourth at Newcastle in February (6f); hopes rest on the switch to turf giving her a lift.

runners.comment: 11th-time lucky when scoring at Pontefract last month; 4lb higher and drawn widest today
runners.name: Maynora
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the 11th attempt when always prominent at Pontefract early last month (6f, good to soft); a 4lb rise and stall 1 could be his downfall this time.

runners.comment: Still to build on the promise of his debut; connections now reach for headgear
runners.name: Solar Cooper
runners.spotlight: Ran well on his 2yo debut but little to celebrate since; slowly edging down the weights and now tried in headgear but others look safer.

runners.comment: Won a seller last June but handicaps have proved more challenging; now tried in headgear
runners.name: Carnation Queen
runners.spotlight: Won a York seller last summer (6f, good to firm); handicaps have proved more demanding and she was well short of her best at Southwell 17 days ago; headgear now reached for.

runners.comment: Just touched off at Redcar ten days ago; a 2lb rise shouldn't prevent another big run
runners.name: Im Dan Dare
runners.spotlight: He took a good step forward on his second handicap run ten days ago (6f, good; cheekpieces first time), always prominent and only picked off close home; up 2lb but not fully exposed.

runners.comment: Promise despite her unappealing form-figures as a 2yo; market useful now handicapping
runners.name: Luck Money
runners.spotlight: Shaped okay on her debut in a Leicester maiden that looks a lot stronger now than it did at the time; absent for 181 days but she is open to plenty of improvement now handicapping at a modest level; market useful with the stable running another similar type in Kode Grey.

runners.comment: Drops back in class with his seasonal/stable debut under his belt; can do better today
runners.name: Call Me By My Name
runners.spotlight: Early promise for James Horton last season but his campaign rather fizzled out; dropped away in the final 300yds at Haydock on his seasonal/stable debut three weeks ago but he may have needed the run and that was a 0-70; should last longer today.

runners.comment: Potential improver now handicapping at a modest level; betting to guide
runners.name: Kode Grey
runners.spotlight: He has run to a modest level in three maiden/novice runs this year (6f/7f; Tapeta, good to soft) but it would be no surprise were he to take a good step forward now handicapping at a modest level; needs a close look in the betting; yard also runs Luck Money.

runners.comment: Promising 3rd on handicap/turf debut; twice beaten over 1m since; unexposed as a sprinter
runners.name: Battenburg Belle
runners.spotlight: Ran well for third at Pontefract (6f, good to soft) on her turf and handicap debut in April; not built on it in two 1m runs since but could still have potential as a sprinter.

runners.comment: Modest maiden; little evidence to suggest she is the answer today
runners.name: Dance Hello
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden who finished out the back on her seasonal debut at Wolverhampton in March (6f; made the running); nothing so far to suggest she is well handicapped.

14:35.race_name: Racing Welfare Supporting Mental Health Awareness Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Won five-runner Exeter maiden over 2m last month; can improve again over this longer trip
runners.name: Our Guide
runners.spotlight: Joined Jamie Snowden after Irish bumper win in October; made underwhelming stable/hurdle debut in March but justified odds-on favouritism in five-runner Exeter maiden (2m, good) last month and is open to significant further improvement over this longer trip; leading contender.

runners.comment: Well beaten when 33-1 for last month's hurdle debut at Hereford (2m3f)
runners.name: Granite Sands
runners.spotlight: Made a quite encouraging bumper debut in March 2025 but his second bumper run was disappointing and he was also well beaten when 33-1 for last month's hurdle debut at Hereford (2m3f, good).

runners.comment: Made a fairly useful rival work quite hard when second (well held in end) on hurdle debut
runners.name: Ka Mate Du Brivet
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner; tailed off in a bumper on rules debut in February but made a fairly useful rival work quite hard when second of three (albeit well held in the end) over hurdles at Fontwell (2m5f, good) in March; has another big role to play.

runners.comment: Kept on steadily for modest fourth at Chepstow last month; further progress possible
runners.name: Shuil Rocco
runners.spotlight: Bettered hurdle debut when keeping on steadily for modest fourth at Chepstow (2m3f, good) last month; needs to progress again over this longer trip but that's possible.

runners.comment: Pulled up in a hunter chase on last year's rules debut and in a point in February
runners.name: Tiger Tobin
runners.spotlight: Maiden point winner in 2024; struggled when making rules debut in 3m2f hunter chase last spring and again pulled up when reappearing in a point in February; can only be watched on stable/hurdle debut.

runners.comment: Pulled up when 300-1 for hurdling debut at Hereford (2m3f) in December
runners.name: At Sunrise
runners.spotlight: Safely held in two bumpers last spring and pulled up when 300-1 for hurdling debut at Hereford (2m3f, good to soft) in December.

runners.comment: Pulled up when a big-priced outsider for last month's hurdle debut (2m4f)
runners.name: Savon
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on bumper debut in March and pulled up when 200-1 for last month's hurdle debut at Ffos Las (2m4f, good to soft).

15:05.race_name: Happy 32nd Birthday Lottie Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Irish point winner; ended last season with two good hurdle runs; chase debut today
runners.name: Captain Cool
runners.spotlight: Just 1-9 over hurdles but ended last season with two good seconds at Sedgefield (both 2m1f, good), and last year's Irish point win also bodes well for his prospects on this chasing debut.

runners.comment: Ran well for long way when third at Chepstow last month; dryer ground could suit here
runners.name: Whatyouwaitingfor
runners.spotlight: Remote when second of three on stable/chase debut but ran well for a long way before weakening into third at Chepstow (2m, good to soft) last month and could be better suited by the forecast dryer ground here.

runners.comment: Ran quite well on latest hurdling start but makes chase debut after 314-day absence
runners.name: Definite Dream
runners.spotlight: 0-9 in points (completed only three times) and has same strike-rate over hurdles; gave a fairly good account when fifth of 15 at Worcester (2m, good) last July but this chasing debut comes after a 314-day absence.

runners.comment: Below form on last two starts; good claims if judged on Sedgefield second in March
runners.name: Intenzo
runners.spotlight: Below form on last two appearances and his tendency to race too freely remains a worry but he made a promising chase/handicap debut when clear second at Sedgefield (2m, good) in March and that form has been well advertised by the winner since; good claims if back at that level.

runners.comment: Bumper winner; well beaten on handicap hurdle debut but quickly switched to fences
runners.name: Alba Crus
runners.spotlight: Good-ground bumper winner who was placed in a 2m3f novice hurdle last season; ran poorly on recent handicap hurdle debut (2m4f) and now has a point to prove but might be aided by first-time tongue-tie here and connections are evidently keen to switch him to fences.

runners.comment: Kept on for third on recent handicap hurdle debut; could have more to offer over fences
runners.name: Miss Denver
runners.spotlight: Well-bred mare; made a low-key start to her hurdling career but kept on for respectable third on recent handicap hurdle debut at Newton Abbot (2m1f, good) and could easily have more to offer over fences.

runners.comment: Ran okay last month, after a break, but others in this field probably have more potential
runners.name: Cawthorne Cracker
runners.spotlight: Course winner over hurdles; returned from a break with respectable third in Market Rasen chase (2m1f, good) last month but is 0-5 over fences now and others in this line-up probably have more potential.

15:35.race_name: Deryck Baker Memorial Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Hurdle/chase winner last spring; returned with lacklustre chase run last month
runners.name: All Inn Hand
runners.spotlight: Won the 2m6f novice hurdle on this card a year ago (good ground) and followed up in handicap chase at Hexham (3m, good to soft) three weeks later, but returned from layoff with lacklustre chase run last month; now reverts to hurdling over new trip and with headgear switched.

runners.comment: Seemingly back in prime form in February but ended last season with two lesser efforts
runners.name: I Am The Moon
runners.spotlight: Seemingly back in good nick when winning readily at Doncaster (2m3f, soft) in February but ended last season with two lesser efforts (3m/2m7f) and has questions to answer again over this new trip.

runners.comment: Safely held on both stable starts, latterly when upped to 2m7f for handicap debut in April
runners.name: Mahon Falls
runners.owner: E W Lewis & Katy Price Racing
runners.spotlight: Placed in three Irish maiden hurdles (2m1f-2m5f) for Willie Mullins in the autumn but safely held on both starts for new stable this spring, latterly when upped to 2m7f for handicap debut at Fakenham (good); upped in trip again; needs to raise her game.

runners.comment: Led close home in new blinkers last month; still on a good mark and unexposed as a stayer
runners.name: Jena dOudairies
runners.spotlight: Led close home to score in first-time blinkers at Taunton (3m, good) last month and is now 2-11 over hurdles; not always one to rely upon heavily but remains well handicapped on older form and unexposed as a stayer.

runners.comment: Ex-pointer; fourth at big odds on rules debut but well beaten twice since; handicap debut
runners.name: Dunaden Island
runners.spotlight: 1-9 in points; belied triple-digit odds when fourth on rules debut at Wincanton (1m7f, heavy) in February but well beaten twice since (1m7f/2m5f); upped in trip for handicap debut; opening mark demands improvement.

16:05.race_name: William Austin 50 Year Celebration Mares' Handicap Chase (Queen Boudicca Mares' Chase Series Qual')

runners.comment: Back from long absence with two underwhelming hurdle runs this year; chase debut today
runners.name: Pure Seduction
runners.spotlight: Made the frame in two Irish points in 2024 and won good-ground maiden hurdle later that year; returned from long absence with two disappointing handicap hurdle runs this year (2m3f/2m; last of six both times), though, and is tricky to weigh up for this chasing debut.

runners.comment: On workable mark if judged on hurdle form; well beaten over C&D on chase debut in March
runners.name: Ballyhiho
runners.spotlight: On workable mark if judged on last year's hurdling form and had soft ground as an excuse for below-par run in March two runs back; well beaten over C&D (good) on chasing debut later that month, though, and needs to rebound.

runners.comment: Runner-up off today's mark on last two appearances; likely contender again
runners.name: A Little Something
runners.spotlight: Pulled up when making chase debut on heavy ground but runner-up twice on good ground since, latterly at Fontwell (2m3f) last month; gets another chance off the same mark here; obvious contender.

runners.comment: Made all on chasing debut; flopped next time but may still have potential
runners.name: Little Wren
runners.spotlight: Displayed significant improvement when fitted with cheekpieces for chasing debut at Fakenham (2m5f, good to soft) in January, making all to win by just over 7l; lacked fluency and was pulled up at Plumpton (3m1f, soft) the following month but has strong claims if back on song after 97-day break.

runners.comment: Started off for new stable with two disappointing runs (chase/hurdle); revival needed
runners.name: Miss Fedora
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle and dual chase winner when trained by Seamus Mullins; very disappointing joint-favourite when pulled up in a chase for new stable in March and finished down the field over hurdles last month; needs to turn things around.

16:35.race_name: Boss & The Hoggs Live On The 30th May Handicap Hurdle

runners.breeder: G Hedley & Mike Channon Bloodstock Ltd
runners.comment: Ran well for a long way on handicap debut and may be better suited by this faster ground
runners.name: Reteti
runners.spotlight: 0-13 under all codes but ran well for a long way before weakening into fifth of seven on handicap hurdle debut at Plumpton (2m, soft) in February and ought to be better suited by the forecast faster ground here.

runners.comment: Breakthrough win in November and has remained in good form, 2m1f winner at Aintree Friday
runners.name: A Good Yomp
runners.spotlight: Ridden by Dillon Butler since October; scored at Huntingdon (2m3f, good to soft) in November in a first-time hood, which has been kept since and he's remained in good form; stretched by 2m7f on penultimate start but led three out for a game win at Aintree (2m1f) on Friday night; enters each-way calculations if he turns up here.

runners.comment: 0-6 over hurdles but ran well when close second at Fontwell last month; good chance
runners.name: Frank Stamper
runners.spotlight: 0-6 over hurdles but ran well when close second at Fontwell (2m1f, good to soft) last month and is probably still on a workable mark after 1lb nudge; good chance.

runners.comment: Best of three runs for new stable when third at Taunton last month; respected
runners.name: Galactic Jack
runners.spotlight: Useful on the Flat in his prime; 0-8 over hurdles but posted best of three runs for new stable (since a long absence) when third at Taunton (2m, good; behind Mi Sueno) last month and is another 1lb lower here; respected.

runners.comment: Well beaten in three maiden hurdles but won five times on the Flat in Belgium/Germany
runners.name: Trooper
runners.spotlight: Five-time Flat winner in Belgium/Germany; well beaten in three maiden hurdles this year (last two runs for current stable) but has basement mark for handicap hurdle debut and is well worth a glance in the betting.

runners.comment: Creditable second over hurdles last month but pulled up in a recent chase; hard to predict
runners.name: Mi Sueno
runners.spotlight: Returned to form with creditable second at Taunton (2m, good) last month, his third start for David Brace, but was pulled up on recent chasing debut and has become hard to predict.

runners.comment: Well beaten in three maiden hurdles this year but may fare better in handicaps
runners.name: Prettylady
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in three maiden hurdles for new stable in early part of this year but showed some ability on the Flat when trained in France, and the switch to forecast good ground may enable some improvement on this handicap hurdle debut.

runners.comment: Well beaten on soft-ground handicap debut but recent good-ground run was more encouraging
runners.name: Blazing Gaden
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on soft-ground handicap debut in March but last month's fifth (behind Mi Sueno and Galactic Jack) at Taunton (2m, good) was more encouraging and further progress is possible, albeit 3lb out of the handicap today.

17:05.race_name: Ladies Day On Sunday 19th July Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Three chase wins in early part of last season; ran okay last month, after a break; player
runners.name: King Roly
runners.spotlight: Won three small-field chases in early part of last season (2m3f-2m4f, good) and ran better than eventual 18l defeat suggests at Perth (2m4f, good; hampered by final-fence faller) last month, after a layoff; will be fine over today's longer trip and goes on the shortlist.

runners.comment: Back from break with two disappointing runs towards end of last season; has bit to prove
runners.name: Jubilant
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with emphatic win from the front at Plumpton (3m1f, good to soft), his third chase success, but returned from break with two disappointing runs (chase/hurdle) towards end of last season and has something to prove.

runners.breeder: Stephen Kemble Bloodstock Ltd & G Peck
runners.comment: Scored over C&D in March and didn't run badly at Newton Abbot last month; respected
runners.name: Tapley
runners.spotlight: 2-10 over fences, the latter win gained over C&D (good) in March; didn't run badly when third of four at Newton Abbot (2m5f, good) last month and seems likely to be on the premises again.

runners.comment: Off since poor run in October and still on fairly tough mark; headgear switched
runners.name: Bagheera Ginge
runners.spotlight: Made all in small field at Newton Abbot (3m2f, good) in September but absent since running poorly in Sedgefield marathon three weeks later and needs to resume in peak form to have a chance off current mark; swaps usual cheekpieces for first-time visor.

runners.comment: Off since December but has good record when fresh and Sean Bowen is booked
runners.name: Okavango Delta
runners.spotlight: Absent since below-par run in December but returned from break with creditable second at Musselburgh (2m, good to soft; stays much further) in November and won when fresh last spring; has travelled from Northumberland for this race and Sean Bowen is booked; interesting.

runners.comment: Not at best when making the frame on his two starts in March; others appeal more
runners.name: Diplomatic Ash
runners.spotlight: Finished weakly when well-held fourth at Kempton (3m, good) in March and was also below best at Ascot (2m5f, good; refitted cheekpieces) later that month, where he plugged on from a long way off the pace to take a modest second; current mark is workable but others appeal more.

runners.comment: Ex-Irish veteran; safely held on both stable starts; cheekpieces now tried
runners.name: Arrycan
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish veteran who was safely held on first two starts for new stable this spring (both 3m, good); needs good boost from new cheekpieces here.

runners.comment: Dual Worcester chase winner last summer; absent since poor hurdle run in November
runners.name: Grillon De Monty
runners.spotlight: Dual chase winner at Worcester (2m7f, good) last summer; absent since heavy defeat over hurdles in November, though, and resumes on fairly tough mark; hooded for first time.

17:35.race_name: Family Day On Sunday 12th July Open Maiden National Hunt Flat Race (Category 3 Elimination) (GBB)

runners.comment: Just a respectable fourth on recent Fontwell debut but ought to have learnt from that
runners.name: Lightsoutandaway
runners.spotlight: Brother to a Listed Flat winner; just a respectable fourth of nine on recent debut at Fontwell (good) but contests what looks another modest race here and ought to have learnt from that experience.

runners.comment: Trainer has good bumper strike-rate (17%) and has booked Sean Bowen for this newcomer
runners.name: Scotto
runners.spotlight: Sixth foal; brother to hurdle/chase winner Brayhill, half-brother to useful hurdler Chooseyourweapon and a point winner; dam pulled up in points, out of a useful bumper/jumps winner; trainer has pretty good bumper strike-rate (17%) and has booked Sean Bowen for this newcomer.

runners.comment: Fourth on both starts, latterly at Hereford (good) last month; in the mix again here
runners.name: Bound For Glory
runners.spotlight: Out of a fair Flat/hurdle winner; fourth on both starts, more recently on good ground at Hereford last month; that form isn't anything to go wild about but he'll probably be on the premises again here.

runners.comment: Off since well held in December; big player if judged on promising debut in November
runners.name: Macs Max
runners.spotlight: Flat-bred 4yo; absent since disappointing run on soft ground in December but made promising debut when second to a subsequent hurdle winner at Newcastle (good to soft) in November, and that performance makes him of strong interest here.

runners.comment: Won a point bumper on debut but well beaten in both subsequent rules bumpers
runners.name: Angel Of My Dreams
runners.spotlight: Made all in a point bumper in March 2025 but well beaten in two rules bumpers last season; not written off just yet but needs addition of hood/tongue-tie to make a big difference.

runners.breeder: E A R L De Faydeau
runners.comment: Pulled up when 100-1 for British debut at Taunton in March
runners.name: Law Of The Jungle
runners.spotlight: Only eighth of nine on debut in France in summer 2024 and pulled up when reappearing for new stable at Taunton (good; 100-1) in March.
